functions.name: toAbsolutePath
functions.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The stack level to get the script path of, if `base` is `nil`.

parameters.name: relativePath
parameters.description: The relative path to the file.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path to the file relative to the script directory.

returns.name: exists
returns.description: True if the file exists, false otherwise.

functions.name: list
functions.description: Returns the files and folders present in the given directory.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the directory to list relative to the script directory.

returns.name: contents
returns.descriptions: Contents of the directory. Will be empty when the path doesn't exist.

classes.name: DirectoryContents
classes.description: List of file and subfolder names in a directory
